_note: The four playable leaders (bible §6). One leads at a time; each has a battle command (leader assist: once per battle, free, it doesn't use up the Patchling's move). 'line' is what they say when picked; portraits are placeholders until the M4 trainer sprites. 'color' is the main colour of their outfit (bible §6 Looks), used for their buttons and cards.

callum.name: Callum
callum.field: Reads creature lore, fills bestiary entries, spots rares.

assist.name: Scan
assist.desc: Reveals the foe's type and weaknesses. Counts toward Studied.

callum.line: Right. Gotta seal 'em all. I'm keeping a spreadsheet.

nolan.name: Nolan

assist.name: Patch Up
assist.desc: Heals half your Patchling's HP and cures its status.

nolan.line: Someone has to be the responsible one. Again.

haydon.name: Haydon

assist.name: Taunt
assist.desc: Riles the foe up: its Defense and Sp. Def fall.

haydon.line: Trapped in a video game? Nah that's cap.

dani.name: Dani
dani.field: Befriends anything, tanks for the group.

assist.name: Shield
assist.desc: Halves the next hit your Patchling takes.

dani.line: I don't care about Pokémon. But okay, I play. Five minutes.
